name: Embed
description: A YouTube, Vimeo, Buzzsprout or Spotify URL. A bare link on its own line also works. Settings rows: url, ratio (e.g. 16:9), title, poster (image). An .mp4 url plays as a native video with the poster.

options.label: vimeo
options.description: A source Vimeo clip: rows url (the vimeo.com link), file (the clip's MP4 master) and title. It plays in the Vimeo player where Vimeo allows this site, else the MP4 with the same Vimeo-style controls (play, progress, volume, speed, picture-in-picture, fullscreen).
